questions.question: The volume of a right circular cone, whose radius of the base is half of its altitude, and the volume of a hemisphere are equal. The ratio of the radius of the cone to the radius of the hemisphere is:
questions.solution:
Let the radius of the cone be r₁ and the radius of the hemisphere be r₂,

The radius of the base is half of its altitude,

⇒ r₁ = h/2

Volume of the cone = Volume of the hemisphere

⇒ (1/3)πr₁²h = (2/3)πr₂³

⇒ (1/3) h³/4 = (2/3)r₂³

⇒ r₂³ = h³/8

Taking cube root on both sides we get,

⇒ r2 = h/2

We know for cone,

⇒ r₁ = h/2

So, r1 = r₂

**∴ r₁/r₂ = 1 : 1**

questions.question: A ball, thrown vertically upward, rises to a height of 80 m and returns to its original position. The magnitude of its displacement after 7 s of motion will be _______. (take g = 10m/s²)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**35 m**__.

As the ball is thrown vertically upward, it rises to a height of 80m (given in ques)

At the height of 80m, the velocity of the ball, v = 0

so according to Newton's equation of motion, v² = u² + 2gs

where v = final velocity

u = initial velocity

s = distance

g = acceleration due to gravity

We know that,

v² = u² - 2as

0 = u² - 2(10)(80)

[g is taken as -ve because the ball is thrown vertically upwards i.e against the gravity of the earth]

⇒ u = 40m/s ​

Also, s = ut - 1/2 at²

Now displacement after 7 sec

s = 40 × 7 - 1/2 (10) (7)²

s = 280 - 245

s = 35 m

questions.question: If x² + ax + b, when divided by x - 3, leaves a remainder of 22 and x² + bx + a, when divided by x - 3, leaves a remainder of 24, then a + b = ?
questions.solution:
x² + ax + b, when divided by x - 3, leaves a remainder of 22,

⇒ 9 + 3a + b = 22

⇒ 3a + b = 13

when divided by x - 3, leaves a remainder of 24,

⇒ 9 + 3b + a = 24

⇒ 3b + a = 15

Solving,

⇒ 4a + 4b = 28

∴ a + b = 7

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 60 years. Six years ago, father’s age was five times the age of the son. After 6 years, son’s age will be:
questions.solution:
The sum of the present ages of the father and his son is 60 years,

⇒ S + F = 60

Six years ago, father’s age was five times the age of the son,

⇒ (F - 6) = 5(S - 6)

⇒ F - 6 = 5S - 30

⇒ 5S - F = 24

Solving,

⇒ 5S - 60 + S = 24

⇒ 6S = 84

⇒ S = 14

∴ After 6 years Son’s age = 14 + 6 = 20 years.

questions.question: If x² + kx + k = 0 has two distinct real solutions, then the value of k will satisfy:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a quadratic equation to have two distinct real roots, the discriminant D must be greater than 0.

Equation: x² + kx + k = 0 ⇒ a = 1, b = k, c = k.

D = b² − 4ac = k² − 4k.

Condition: k² − 4k > 0 ⇒ k(k − 4) > 0.

The expression is positive when k lies outside the range [0, 4].

**∴ The correct answer is k 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given Equation: x² + kx + k = 0

Formula Used: For distinct real roots, Discriminant D = b² − 4ac > 0

⇒ Comparing with ax² + bx + c = 0, we get a = 1, b = k, and c = k.

⇒ D = (k)² − 4 × 1 × k

⇒ D = k² − 4k

⇒ For two distinct real solutions, k² − 4k > 0

⇒ Factorizing the expression: k × (k − 4) > 0

⇒ The roots of the quadratic inequality are k = 0 and k = 4.

⇒ By the wavy curve method, k(k − 4) is positive when k 4.

**∴ The correct answer is k 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Nature of Roots

For ax² + bx + c = 0, roots are real and distinct if D > 0, real and equal if D = 0, and imaginary (non-real) if D < 0.

Discriminant

The discriminant D = b² − 4ac determines the nature of the roots without solving the equation.

Sum and Product of Roots

For the equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots is −b/a and the product of roots is c/a.

questions.question: For how many positive integers ‘n’, n³ - 8n² + 20n - 13 is a prime number?
questions.solution:
n³ - 8n² + 20n - 13 = (n - 1)(n² - 7n + 13)

In order to make (n - 1) prime it will either be __+__1 or (n² - 7n + 13) be __+__1

⇒ n - 1 = __+__1

⇒ n = 0 or 2

Then,

⇒ n³ - 8n² + 20n - 13 = -13

Or, (n² - 7n + 13) = __+__1

If (n2 - 7n + 13) = 0

⇒ n = 3, 4

∴ For n = 0, the value of expression = -13

∴ For n = 2, the value of expression = 3

∴ For n = 3, the value of expression = 2

∴ For n = 4, the value of expression = 3

∴ Possible values of n = 2, 3 and 4

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

n³- 8n²+ 20n – 13, where n is a positive integer.

N = 1, We get

⇒ 1³ – 8(1)² + 20(1) – 13

⇒ 1 – 8 + 20 – 13

⇒ 21 – 21

⇒ 0, Not a prime number

n = 2, We get

⇒ 2³ – 8(2)² + 20(2) – 13

⇒ 3

Similarly,

n = 3

⇒ 2, Prime number

n = 4

⇒ 3, Prime number

n = 5

⇒ 12, Not prime number

n = 6

⇒ 35, Not prime number

So, We can say that there are only 3 positive integers which gives us prime numbers.

• As the spring unwinds or compressed, some work is done Thus, the wound spring has the potential to do work means have more energy than the spring of normal length

Definition

 
 
 

 
 
Heat Energy

 
 
 
The heat energy of an object is the overall energy of the molecules that arise due to the motion of the molecules.

 
 
 

 
 
Chemical Energy

 
 
 
The Energy produced by breaking or forming chemical bonds between atoms and molecules is called Chemical Energy

 
 
 

 
 
Kinetic Energy

 
 
 
Kinetic energy is the energy possessed by virtue of its motion

 
K.E = ½mv²

 
Where m = mass of a body

 
v = velocity of body

questions.solution:
**Spherical Mirror**

 
 
 

 
 
__**Aperture**__

 
 
 
__**The diameter of the reflecting surface of a spherical mirror is called Aperture**__

 
 
 

 
 
Focus

 
 
 
The point at which the light rays concentrate or appear to concentrate after reflecting from the spherical mirror is called the focus of the spherical mirror.

 
It is represented by letter 'F'.

 
 
 

 
 
Principal axis

 
 
 
Principle axis is not a fixed axis for a mirror. It can be any normal to the surface taken according to convenience such that the sign conventions become easier to observe.

 
 
 

 
 
Pole

 
 

 
 
 
The center of the reflecting surface of a spherical mirror is called the Pole.

 
The Pole lies on the surface of the mirror and is represented as 'P'.

 
 
 

 
 
Centre of Curvature

 
 
 
It is the center of the sphere and the reflecting surface forms the part of that sphere.

 
It is denoted by letter 'C'.

 
 
 

 
 
Radius of Curvature

 
 
 
It is the radius of the sphere of which the reflecting surface of a spherical mirror forms a part, and is represented as 'R'.

questions.question: Yayati sold an item at a loss of 13%, If he had sold it for Rs. 49 more, he would have made a profit of 22%. What should be the selling price of the item to gain a profit of 30%?
questions.solution:
Let C.P of item be Rs. M

Loss percentage = 13%

⇒ 13M = 100C.P - 100SP

⇒ C.P = 100S.P/87

⇒ S.P = 87C.P/100

If he had sold it for Rs. 49 more, he would have made a profit of 22%,

⇒ New S.P = 87C.P/100 + 49

⇒ 22C.P = 87C.P + 4900 - 100C.P

⇒ C.P = 140

Profit percentage = 30%

⇒ 30 × 140 = 100S.P - 14000

∴ S.P = Rs. 182

questions.question: A mini-van crosses two people walking at the speed of 4.8 km/h and 6 km/h in the same direction as that in which the mini-van is heading in 4.5 s and 9 s, respectively. What is the length of the mini-van?
questions.solution:
Let the length of mini-van be ‘N’ m and the speed of the van be ‘A’ km/h

A mini-van crosses people walking at the speed of 4.8 km/h in the same direction as that in which the mini-van is heading in 4.5,

⇒ N/(A - 4.8) = 1/800

⇒ 800N = A - 4.8 ----1

A mini-van crosses two people walking at the speed of 6 km/h in the same direction as that in which the mini-van is heading in 9 s,

⇒ N/(A - 6) = 1/400

⇒ 400N = A - 6 ----2

Solving equation 1 and 2,

400N = 800N + 4.8 - 0.6

⇒ 400N - 800N = -1.2

⇒ 400N = 1.2 km

⇒ N = 3 m

∴ The length of the mini-van is 3 m.

questions.question: The median of the numbers 3, 1, 1, 5, 2 and 7 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numbers 3, 1, 1, 5, 2 and 7

**Formula used:**

Arrange the data in ascending order.

If n = odd term then median = (n + 1)TH term is the median

If n = even term then median = ((n/2)TH + (n/2 + 1)TH)/2 is the median 

**Calculation:**

Number arranged in ascending order = 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7

⇒ Median = (2 + 3)/2 = 2.5

**∴ The median of the numbers 3, 1, 1, 5, 2 and 7 is 2.5.**

questions.question:
Read the given question and decide which of the following arguments is (are) strong.

**Question:** Are the best things in life free?

**Argument 1:** Life gives us so many opportunities for free and yet most of us waste it.

**Argument 2:** Smiles, friends, family, good talks, good sleep and happy memories are all free.
questions.solution:
Argument 2 state that, smiles, friends, family, good talks, good sleep and happy memories are all free. This is a strong argument because smiles, friends, family good talks, good sleep and happy memories are the best things a person can have and can cherish, and also, they are free.

Argument 1 states that life gives us so many opportunities for free and yet most of us waste it. Smiles, friends and many other good things and opportunities are given for free but many of us do not cherish them and take them for granted, hence, and waste them. This concludes, that we only waste the best things in life, because we do not have to work for it. That again proves the fact that best things in life are free, that is why most of us waste them.

Therefore, both the arguments 1 and 2 are strong.
